name: Camping Edelweiss
beschreibung: Camping Edelweiss is situated in Neustift im Stubaital surrounded by the Stubai Alps. The campsite offers pitches for caravans, motorhomes, and tents, as well as rental apartments and cabins. A heated outdoor pool and a sauna are available for relaxation and recreation. In summer, the site serves as an ideal base for hikes and mountain bike tours throughout the Stubai Valley. In winter, quick connections lead directly to nearby ski areas including the Stubai Glacier.
